name: Laurna Morninglight
summary: In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight teaches young night elf priests the rites of Elune. Devoted to the Sisterhood of Elune, she guides acolytes from Shadowglen in healing and spiritual practice as threats gather in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Guide in Dolanaar
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight guides young priests from Shadowglen. As new initiates travel farther into Teldrassil, she teaches them to deepen their bond with Elune. Her lessons join healing with defensive rites, skills needed in an increasingly hostile wild.

sections.title: Devotion to the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Among the kaldorei, priestcraft follows Elune, not the Holy Light revered by humans and dwarves. Laurna sends her students to receive sacred robes and heal a wounded Sentinel. Through these rites, acolytes learn that the Mother Moon grants their power to preserve and mend the kaldorei people.

faq.q: Where can I find Laurna Morninglight?
faq.answer: Find Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar, in central Teldrassil, just down the road from Shadowglen.
Laurna Morninglight trains night elf priests. She teaches new spells, improves familiar abilities, and guides them through early class rites.

faq.q: What kind of quests does she offer?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight sends fledgling priests to aid wounded allies and seek Elune's favor through ceremonial vestments and prayers.
Laurna Morninglight is rooted in the Sisterhood of Elune, and Alliance priest trainers instruct any allied priest who seeks spiritual discipline.

faq.q: Is she affiliated with the Temple of the Moon?
faq.answer: Yes. Laurna Morninglight's vows and magic are dedicated to Elune and the traditions overseen by the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Does she share a family name with other night elves?
faq.answer: No relatives of Laurna Morninglight are known among the kaldorei of Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf priest arriving from Shadowglen, you can turn to Laurna Morninglight for foundational spells and guidance in devotion to Elune.
As a night elf, you follow the kaldorei devotion to the Moon Goddess. In Teldrassil, priestcraft draws on Elune rather than the Holy Light.
